reason: The color tools change preset-name nullability, interface augmentation support, root override precedence and default controls/palettes. A major release communicates the required consumer review and migration.
breakingChanges: GradientPreset.name is optional; consumers reading it must handle undefined.
ColorPickerStyles and GradientMakerStyles are mapped aliases and cannot be declaration-merged as interfaces.
Root className now overrides conflicting classNames.root utilities on both color tools.
Default palettes, visible controls and GradientMaker's internal angle DOM change.
Applying a preset without an angle preserves the editor angle instead of resetting to 90.
migration: See docs/release-review-2.0.0.md. Guard optional preset names, replace style-interface augmentation with local intersection types, resolve conflicting root overrides, supply explicit palettes and visibility props when preserving layouts, set angle: 90 on presets that must reset it, and migrate Slider-specific selectors to GradientMaker slots. This draft requires a version update, fresh fingerprint and final compatibility review before becoming release-plan.json.
